integrity: Analytic proof for all indices at least 61, exhaustive integer membership over 2..60, separately confirmed by Apéry genus; record contains all required standalone evidence.
scientific_limitations: This classifies symmetry only, not all Frobenius numbers, genera, polygonal families or generator block lengths. Published general symmetry criteria are used. A finite exact checker is auxiliary to the infinite proof; no independent external audit has been performed.
title: Exactly six symmetric semigroups from consecutive hexagonal triples
